title: Full EDGAR SIC census of semiconductor-related filers (SIC 3674, 3559, 3825, 3827, 3089, 7372, 5065) using declared bulk downloads
why_it_matters: SIC 3674 alone misses most equipment, materials, EDA and distribution companies; a bulk pull of submissions.zip filtered by SIC, filer status and latest filing date would give the complete US-registered population and its active subset.
questions: How many active (filed in last 18 months) EDGAR filers are in SIC 3674, and how many are in each adjacent code?
What share of SIA/SEMI members filing with the SEC sit outside SIC 3674?
Which foreign chip companies file 20-F/40-F and under which SIC?

title: Enumerate Korean and Japanese listed chip-supply-chain companies via OpenDART and EDINET APIs (industry codes, keys required)
why_it_matters: Neither KRX nor JPX publishes a semiconductor sector list; the regulators' APIs expose industry codes (DART induty_code, EDINET XBRL industry tags) but need registered keys, which this run could not use.
questions: Which KSIC codes does DART's induty_code use, and how many KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX firms fall in KSIC 261xx and semiconductor-equipment codes?
Which EDINET industry code or TSE 17/33-sector values contain Japanese chip, equipment and materials firms?
How to map these to ontology roles?

title: Enumerate mainland China listed and pre-IPO chip companies (STAR/ChiNext/main boards, CSRC IPO guidance filings, CAPCO classification)
why_it_matters: About 240 A-share IC companies are implied but no official constituent list was found; CSRC IPO-guidance reports and SSE prospectuses also reveal private firms (CXMT, YMTC) before listing.
questions: Which A-share companies does SSE/CAPCO/CNINFO classify as integrated-circuit or semiconductor firms, and by which code?
Which chip companies are in CSRC IPO guidance (辅导) or listing review now?
What do STAR prospectuses disclose on capacity, customers and state shareholders?
